result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but there are a couple of minor visual inconsistencies worth noting.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' row shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' entries with the same image, delivery time (15-25 min), and delivery fee (€0.90), which appears to be a duplicated listing.
issues.suggestion: Verify the data source to ensure distinct restaurants are displayed, or remove the duplicate entry if it is unintended.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the 'Popular right now' cards are styled inconsistently — the first card has a white heart on a light circular background while the second has a white heart on a dark circular background, creating uneven visual treatment.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button background and icon styling across all cards for visual consistency.
